name: PdxFormTemplate
description:
Renders a complete form from a FormSchema: each field type gets its control, validators run from
the schema and sections become fieldsets. With `layout: 'wizard'` the sections are the steps of a
`pdx-wizard`, and a step with an error is not left.

members.name: form
members.description: Optional pre-existing Form instance. If not provided, one is created from schema.

members.name: autocomplete
members.description: HTML autocomplete attribute for the generated form.

members.name: formClass
members.description: CSS class applied to the generated form.

members.name: showActions
members.description: Show default submit/reset buttons. Override via slot="actions".

members.name: getForm
members.description: The Form the template renders: the `form` prop, or the one created from the schema.

members.name: next
members.description: The next step, once the current one is valid. A promise: the validation may be async.

members.name: goTo
members.description: A step by index; forward only once the current step is valid.

events.name: pdx-submit
events.description: The form submitted and its values validate; an invalid submit fires nothing and scrolls to the first error.

attributes.name: autocomplete
attributes.description: HTML autocomplete attribute for the generated form.

attributes.name: formclass
attributes.description: CSS class applied to the generated form.

attributes.name: showactions
attributes.description: Show default submit/reset buttons. Override via slot="actions".

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Replaces the default actions (the `pdx-form-actions` shown when `showActions`). Not rendered in the wizard layout, which has its own navigation.

cssParts.name: content
cssParts.description: The box the generated fields go in.

cssParts.name: section
cssParts.description: A section's `<fieldset>`, outside the wizard layout.

cssParts.name: wizard
cssParts.description: The `pdx-wizard` of the wizard layout; its panels are its `panel` parts.
